knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The contamination pathway is from the toilet to a touched surface.
Aerosols spread droplets that can carry soil and product.
The contaminated tool is replaced and the correction is recorded.

practicalCriteria: Prepares a toilet-only tool set and keeps it apart from other tools.
Applies the approved product to compatible surfaces following the label.
Replaces a tool that crosses zones and records the correction.
passRule: No cross-use of toilet tools, no unapproved mixing, no damaged finish, and all visible soil removed in the practical. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Toilet tool used on a clean-touch surface and not corrected
Damage to a finish during the task
